issues.description: audio_format is built by f-string from sample_rate with no validation against the STTAudioFormat literal set.
issues.detail: Passing sample_rate=11025 or 32000 silently produces 'pcm_11025', which the STTAudioFormat Literal forbids and the server will reject opaquely. typing.cast suppresses the type check rather than enforcing it. Validate sample_rate against the documented set at __init__ (or map through a dict) and fail fast with a clear ValueError.

issues.description: Reconnect scaffolding is dead code: _reconnect_event is never set and task failures swallow exceptions.
issues.detail: The outer while-loop only re-enters on _reconnect_event, but nothing sets it; transient WS failures kill the stream. tasks_group.exception() is called for side effect, discarding real errors from send/recv, and APIConnectionError raised inside _process_stream_event is swallowed by a bare except in recv_task. Either wire reconnect on failure and re-raise APIConnectionError, or delete the scaffolding.

issues.description: Documented parameter ranges are not enforced at construction.
issues.detail: Docstring asserts vad_silence_threshold_secs in [0.3, 3.0], vad_threshold in [0.1, 0.9], and duration fields in [50, 2000], but __init__ performs no validation. Out-of-range values fail opaquely on the server after WS connect. Validate at __init__ and raise ValueError with the actual bounds so the precondition is checked where it is stated.

issues.description: _speaking state machine and committed_transcript handling are implicit, untested, and brittle across reconnects.
issues.detail: An empty committed_transcript signals end-of-segment while non-empty keeps _speaking=True; a non-empty commit without a terminator (network drop, reconnect) sticks _speaking True and suppresses future START_OF_SPEECH. _reconnect_event does not reset state. Make segment identity explicit (segment_id + state) or a pure transition function, document the invariant, and reset on reconnect.

issues.description: STTOptions duplicates __init__ defaults and complects audio_format with sample_rate across two locations.
issues.detail: The dataclass defaults (model_id, audio_format, sample_rate) restate __init__ defaults, and NotGivenOr-to-None translation is repeated inline. audio_format is a function of sample_rate but stored as if independent, so changing a default requires lockstep edits. Make STTOptions the single source of truth via a from_kwargs classmethod and derive audio_format where needed.

issues.description: Per-frame dict+json.dumps+base64 on the 50ms hot path is the wrong data structure.
issues.detail: At 16kHz/50ms chunks the send loop allocates a dict, JSON-encodes it, and base64-encodes 1600 bytes 20 times per second per stream. Constants are heavy: dict allocation, json.dumps, str->bytes conversion. Pre-build the static envelope once or use a bytes template; this is the critical hot path where measurement and optimization are warranted before shipping.

synthesis.summary: Panel consensus: NEEDS-WORK before landing. Two real defects must be fixed: sample_rate-to-audio_format silently produces invalid pcm_ strings (type cast lies), and the reconnect scaffolding is dead code that also swallows APIConnectionError from the recv loop. Documented parameter ranges are not enforced at __init__, and the _speaking/committed_transcript state machine is implicit, untested, and does not reset on reconnect. STTOptions duplicates defaults and complects audio_format with sample_rate. The diff is the right shape — a clean STTv2 mirror of the Deepgram pattern — but needs validation, reconnect wiring, and at least one unit test over _process_stream_event.
